notes: Strip d: x 5270-6410, picks within 4970-6710. Plate 70 is turned: the grid runs about 27-30 deg off the image axes (N-S streets like Brewster/Clarion/Clough slope ~0.55-0.6 px x per px y). Montgomery Road along the top edge and Madison Road along the bottom edge are both partly cut by the plate edge; neither name is printed in this strip (only 'ROAD'), named from their position and the streets that meet them. Duck Creek Road: printed 'DUCK CR...' / '...EEK' (suffix not seen), diagonal NW-SE through the strip with angle points at Hudson and Bevis; its crossing with Section Avenue is at about (6871,3322), just outside the strip. Hudson west of Duck Creek runs to Clough (4857,1891, outside the strip). Wabash: the strip along block 27's south edge (from Clough to Duck Creek) carries a label that reads 'C. AVE.' at (6130,2890) - possibly a misprint or a different name; it lines up with WABASH east of Duck Creek and with WABASH west of block 26 (x~4350), so recorded as Wabash Avenue. Big lettering 'KERPER & BREWSTER'S SUB.', 'LYON'S EST.', 'HERBERT & PROCHOUT'S 1ST/2ND', 'U.A. HOFF..', 'SPENCER & T..', 'FOOTE'S PER M.C.', 'COL. JOHN ... EST.' are subdivision/estate names, not streets. The coloured bands (cyan/pink/orange/yellow) are subdivision boundaries, not streets; the orange/pink line running SSE from Lake Avenue (5770,5180) to Madison is a single property line, not a road, except for its last ~600 px north of Madison (two lines with a 42" sewer, x~5650-5990, y~6030-6900), which may be an unnamed road or sewer right-of-way and was not picked. Unnamed lanes (30 ft and 26 ft) recorded with '?'. Suffix not seen for Clarion, Trimble, Evanston, Duck Creek, Pogue (in this strip).
